title: 2026 Topps Series 1 Lot Fernandez RC McLain Muncy Greatest Hits Insert
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Lots
descriptionText:
Lot of 3 cards from 2026 Topps Series One:

* #116 Yanquiel Fernandez (RC) - Colorado Rockies, Topps 75th Anniversary foil-design base card
* #81 Matt McLain - Cincinnati Reds, Topps 75th Anniversary foil-design base card
* GH-24 Max Muncy - Los Angeles Dodgers, "Greatest Hits" insert (May 31, 2025 - 200th career homer)

Condition: pack-fresh, handled by the edges only. Front and back of every card photographed - please judge corners, edges, surface and centering for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual cards you will receive.
